title: How much protein do you REALLY need? 🍗
caption:
A review of 49 studies: extra protein helped muscle gains up to about 1.6 g per kg of body weight a day, then levelled off. How much do you eat? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 2
first_comment: Your daily protein in grams? Be honest 😅
sources: Morton RW et al. A systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression of the effect of protein supplementation on resistance training-induced gains in muscle mass and strength. Br J Sports Med 2018;52:376-384 (49 trials; benefit plateaued at ~1.6 g/kg/day, CI up to 2.2)
Schoenfeld BJ, Aragon AA. How much protein can the body use in a single meal for muscle-building? J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2018;15:10 (~0.4 g/kg per meal over at least 4 meals)
Jager R et al. ISSN position stand: protein and exercise. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2017;14:20
